name: bootstrap-shadcn-theme
description: A shadcn/ui theme for Bootstrap 5, compiled from vendored Bootstrap Sass source.

scripts.vendor:refresh: shx rm -rf vendor/bootstrap/scss && shx mkdir -p vendor/bootstrap && shx cp -r node_modules/bootstrap/scss vendor/bootstrap/scss
scripts.copy:js: shx mkdir -p dist/js && shx cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
scripts.copy:fonts: shx mkdir -p dist/fonts && shx cp assets/fonts/InterVariable.woff2 dist/fonts/InterVariable.woff2
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:min && npm run prefix && npm run build:js && npm run copy:js && npm run copy:fonts
